description: Updates arrive as pull requests and are merged by a person after CI; nothing merges on its own.
minimumReleaseAge: a release is proposed three days after it was published, so a release that is withdrawn in its first days never reaches a pull request.
helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests: every action stays pinned to a commit, with the version in the comment beside it.

packageRules.description: Generated devcontainer files: the Praetor engine renders them and its audit refuses an edit, so no update is proposed for them.
